full_judgment:
Mr. Md. Ruhul Quddus, J:- This Rule Nisi, at the instance of a judgment debtor in an Artha Rin Decree, was issued calling in question order dated 15.4.2010 passed by the Artha Rin Adalat, Moulvibazar rejecting the petitioner's application for exemption of interest on deposition of the remaining principal amount of loan in Artha Rin Execution Case No.29 of 2003 (arising out of Artha Rin Suit No.3 of 1994). 

 2. Petitioner's case, in short, is that Sonali Bank Ltd, Bhairabganj Bazar Branch, Moulvibazar as plaintiff instituted Artha Rin Suit No.3 of 1994 for recovery of loan amounting to Taka 1,25,844/= only. Ultimately the suit was decreed on 11.3.1995 and the decree holder-bank put the decree in execution by filing Artha Rin Execution Case No.7 of 1997, which was disposed of on 9.10.2003. Thereafter the decree holder-bank filed second application for execution being Artha Rio Execution Case No.29 of 2003 for realisation of Taka 2, I 0,515/= only. 

 4. The decree holder-bank as respondent No.2 has appeared and contested the Rule by filing an affidavit-in-opposition denying the material facts stated in the writ petition raising objection against his (petitioner's) entitlement to get benefit of the said circular dated 24.3.2010. 

 8. Since the petitioner had filed his application before the executing Court on 15.4.2010 i.e within 31.12.2010 on service of a copy upon the learned Advocate for the decree holder-bank, and the prescribed time for taking/giving exemption of interest has expired during pendency of th6 Rule, the petitioner should be allowed to file an application afresh to the respondent-bank, and the bank should also dispose of the same within the scope of circular dated 24.3.2010.
